Testimonials

A name, a role and a company, or it is worth nothing. The quote should say what changed and by how much; "a great product" is filler the reader skips.

A single one, given room

FAQ

Built on .panel-group, at a reading measure, with the card dropped. Answer the objections that stop a sale — price, lock-in, security, migration — rather than the questions that are easy to answer.

What happens to our data if we leave?
Everything is exportable as NDJSON from the API or the interface, including the audit log, at any time and without asking us. Accounts stay readable for 90 days after cancellation.
Do you charge per host or per container?
Neither. The only thing counted is people with an account who did something in the last 30 days. Scaling your infrastructure does not change the bill.
How long does migration usually take?
Most teams are running in a day, because the agent reads the configuration you already have. Importing historical incidents takes longer and is optional.
Where is the data held?
In the region you choose at setup — currently Ireland, Virginia or Sydney — and it does not leave it. Backups stay in the same region.
Is there a free tier for open source?
Yes. Public repositories get the Team plan at no cost, with no limit on the number of engineers.

<details> and <summary> need no script, and a browser can find text inside a closed one — which is more than a scripted accordion manages.

Putting a page together

The order below is conventional because it matches the order of the questions a reader asks. Each band answers one, and a band that answers nothing should come out.

BandThe question it answersLeave it out when
HeroWhat is this and should I keep reading?Never.
Logo wallHas anyone serious tried it?You have fewer than four names worth printing.
FeaturesWhat does it actually do?Never.
StatisticsIs there evidence?The figures need a period you would rather not state.
TestimonialsDid it work for people like me?You cannot attach a real name and role.
PricingWhat will it cost?Never — hiding it loses more readers than any number does.
FAQWhat is the catch?The answers are all in the pricing table already.
Call to actionWhat do I do now?Never.
FooterWhere is everything else?Never.
